scope: Four seeded motel situations and physical squad navigation, restraint, recall and escort approaches against original furniture. Geometry/art unchanged. The full vertical slice remains in progress.

direction_precision.scope: Identical serialized input and pre-shot snapshots produced a one-ULP float-libm aim component difference at tick6366, moving the impact/tracer/sound point. Aim, view/weapon transforms and spread evaluate double sin/cos then round each component once to float. Seven fixed runtime reference vectors regress the old path. Full ordinary-input journals are freshly recorded with the same declared seeds; both shipping replay tools require exact hashes. This finite supported-build check is not a universal libm determinism claim.

changes: Standard preserves original starts and RNG. Three alternative situations use seeded authored floor bays, actual floor/feet/capsule clearance and occupant separation. Busy adds a fourth civilian.
Planning, player/server CLI, native environment configuration, maps, leader scenario requests and journals carry occupancy selection. Protocol/replay39 requires matching peers and fresh saves.

Navigation checks actual start connections and treats original furniture seats/frames as obstacles. Squad cuff approaches use bounded physical side positions and ordinary final approach. Recall reserves local portal approaches and tries supported rear flanks when three normal slots fail. When both doorway sidesteps are occupied, a bounded set of16 extra supported positions give the third officer room to clear the exit. Outside doorways prefer exterior sidesteps and preserve formation goals already clear outside, so recall does not hold a worker inside near a waiting leader.
Aim, weapon transforms and spread use double sin/cos evaluation with a single float rounding; no input RNG consumption, snapshot quantization or hash tolerances changed.

No hand reach, cuff duration, body collision, perception or threat-priority rules were relaxed. Ordinary full mission inputs retain actual stock, damage, cuffing, weapon retrieval and civilian escorts.

portable_fixture_inputs.scope: A platform-specific atan2f in the new fixture generated different mouse yaw bits at tick57. The fixture now uses the game portable angle helper. That preceding fixture-only correction did not change product physics. The final aiming-precision correction is recorded separately; exact state hashes remain required.

negative_controls.meaning: Restoring preceding encounter behavior reproduces the expected physical assertion under the current core and fixture; candidate positive checks pass.

cli.scope: Help/argument parsing only, before game/server initialization

limits: This is a finite fixed-seed functional matrix, not arbitrary layout or human/perception-policy acceptance. Full drivers know the initial plan and use physics queries to choose repeatable ordinary input approaches.
Further seeds, occupied room routes, moving threats and equipment roles remain open, along with initial equipment command selection through clear panes.
Production art/audio/visible handling, policy baselines/evaluation, vehicle interior/panel stacks/suspension and held native visual/focus/stable-load performance acceptance remain open.
